description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generated alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade the application from Spring Boot 2.7.18 to Spring Boot 3.x with Java 21
tasks.reason: The application uses Java 8 and Spring Boot 2.7.18 which are approaching end of support. Upgrading to Spring Boot 3.x with Java 21 ensures long-term support, improved performance, and access to latest security patches.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade Spring Boot from 2.7.18 to the latest 3.x release. Upgrade Java from 8 to 21. Migrate all javax.* imports to jakarta.* namespace. Upgrade Spring Framework from 5.x to 6.x. Ensure all existing functionality continues to work after the upgrade. Update Dockerfile base images to use Java 21.
